long_biography.plain_text:
HEICO’s Flight Support Group is the operating platform most closely shaped by Eric A. Mendelson. Beginning with the company’s parts-development programme in 1992, he helped turn an FAA-approved replacement-parts niche into a broad aerospace business offering airlines alternatives to original-equipment manufacturers.

Growth came through both engineering and acquisition. Mendelson oversaw dozens of purchases while preserving autonomy for acquired businesses. He led the group from its formation and later served for years as HEICO’s co-president. In 2025, he became co-chief executive, sharing corporate leadership with his brother Victor while continuing to run Flight Support.
